profitability.title: Profitability
profitability.load_error: Profitability could not be loaded. Check your active organization and admin access.
profitability.refresh_preview: The operation failed or preview is stale. Refresh the preview before applying.
profitability.unsupported_billing_method: Hourly profitability is unavailable for this billing method.
profitability.basis: Operational estimate: time value less delivery costs, not statutory net profit. Missing costs withhold the complete margin.
profitability.rate_explanation: Rates apply to new entries only. Owner rates represent opportunity cost; employee rates are manual loaded-cost estimates.
profitability.history_explanation: Select entries explicitly. Preview assigns missing snapshots only; existing snapshots and billing rates remain unchanged.
profitability.supplier_explanation: Select entries and eligible project expenses below. Each expense is counted once in the separate expense bucket, with no per-person allocation.
profitability.expense_basis: Recorded expense amount is the cost basis.
profitability.billing_explanation: Work value, invoice value and cash are separate measures; do not add them together. Completeness is independent of cost coverage.
